newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-WEST INDIES 154 FOR SIX AT STUMPS V AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WEST INDIES 154 FOR SIX AT STUMPS V AUSTRALIA.

text.p: The West Indies were 154 for six at the close of play on the third day of their fourth test match at the Adelaide Oval on Monday.
West Indies second innings - 154 for six from 54.3 overs (Brian Lara 65 not out, Michael Bevan three for 56).
Australia first innings - 517 all out in 162.3 overs (Overnight 434 for five) - (Matthew Hayden 125, Mark Waugh 82, Greg Blewett 99, Michael Bevan 85 not out).
West Indies first innings - 130 in 47.5 overs (Michael Bevan four for 31, Shane Warne three for 42.)
